# Gameplay media fixture

`gameplay-preview.webm` and `gameplay-preview.png` were captured from `packages/conformance-cli/test/fixtures/gameplay.html` through the actual Paja/Playwright recorder. The capture used 480 × 320 pixels and a 1000 ms interval; the encoded video duration is 1920 ms. The WebM SHA-256 is `cec63f0e82041d8cf806ddbdae9c84afe8b55b97380531d71d034cd01ac128c3`. These bytes exercise publication metadata and tamper detection. The browser integration test separately proves input-driven motion.
